paragraphs: Isack Hadjar has missed the three races since the summer break ended, sitting out Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid as he recovers from an injury sustained in training. In his absence, Liam Lawson has stepped up into the vacant Red Bull seat, with Yuki Tsunoda filling Lawson’s cockpit at Racing Bulls .
